summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Rio Tinto plc and Rio Tinto Limited, a foreign private issuer, compiling several routine announcements for May 2026. The exhibits include a total voting rights update, PDMR shareholding notices, a substantial holder notice, a project financing milestone, a conference participation, a company secretary appointment, an operational milestone, a payments-to-governments report, and a smelter expansion commissioning. None of these items constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a standard compilation of operational and administrative updates with no event-driven catalyst.
